attempts.input: Attached a very long filename TXT fixture, hovered the card, then removed the attachment.

Read the card text and CSS sizing; the text was clipped with ellipsis.
Hovered the filename and read the enclosing card title; it matched the complete filename.
Removed the long-name attachment and confirmed the draft had zero remaining cards.
